{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crown Prince of Tof''' was the heir to the throne of the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] civilization.<ref name="All Together Now">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref> Only [[Gender/Legends|males]] could inherit the throne within the hereditary monarchy.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Crown Prince of Tof was [[Sereno]], who was captured by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when leading an invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="All Together Now" />
